label: Chainlink VRF v2.5 requirements
summary: Atomic EVM-only requirements for VRF v2.5 request and fulfillment. Select it through --chainlink-product vrf-v2-5; this definition does not prove funding or deployment.
requiredFacts: Subscription or direct-funding mode with exact coordinator, consumer and direct-funding wrapper runtime identities
Key hash, subscription ID when applicable, funding asset, confirmations, callback-gas limit and word count
Every request ID bound to frozen chain, consumer, purpose, input and beneficiary
Authenticated minimal idempotent fulfillment that tolerates duplicate, unknown and reordered request IDs without reverting
Separately callable bounded business transition plus timeout cancel, refund or exit that cannot reroll the same commitment
requiredFiles: Content-addressed EVM-only Chainlink provider profile selecting VRF v2.5
Coordinator, consumer and optional wrapper deployment evidence with runtime-code hashes and dependency lock
Request, fulfillment and deferred business-transition source
Funding, timeout, cancellation, beneficiary-exit and provider-rotation policies
requiredTests: Wrong coordinator, consumer, wrapper, key hash, funding mode, chain and runtime hash
Duplicate, unknown, reordered, delayed and replayed request fulfillment
Callback-gas, word-count, confirmation, funding and total-work bounds
Timeout, cancellation, refund and beneficiary exit without rerolling a frozen commitment
Application-level withholding, selective fulfillment, timing, input-manipulation and authority risks
risks: Request-to-result confusion can apply valid randomness to the wrong action or beneficiary
Provider outage, underfunding or callback-gas exhaustion can strand pending actions
Timeout recovery can become an owner-controlled reroll or value-redirection path
Verifiable provider output does not remove application-level withholding or selection bias
